before.lib/fields.ex:
defmodule Fields do
  @doc "Parse comma-separated integer fields. Whitespace is ignored. Invalid fields raise."
  def parse(value) do
    value |> String.split(",") |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1) |> Enum.map(&String.to_integer/1)
  end
end

after.lib/fields.ex:
defmodule Fields do
  @doc "Parse comma-separated integer fields. Whitespace is ignored. Invalid fields raise."
  defmacro parse(value) do
    quote do
      unquote(value)
      |> String.split(",")
      |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
      |> Enum.map(&String.to_integer/1)
    end
  end
end
after.lib/readers.ex:
defmodule FirstReader do
  require Fields
  def read(value), do: Fields.parse(value)
end
defmodule SecondReader do
  require Fields
  def read(value), do: Fields.parse(value)
end
